tier0.name: Tier 0 Golden Path
tier0.compatibility: Generated service commands are treated as release-blocking external contracts. Removing files, moving paths, changing generated runtime wiring, or changing machine-readable output requires migration notes and release evidence.
tier0.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning the previous golden-path generator behavior, preserving prior generated snapshots, and holding release until layout and version compatibility gates pass.

tier1.name: Tier 1 Compatibility Surfaces
tier1.compatibility: Generated API, RPC, model, and gateway surfaces may add files or helpers, but route layout, import behavior, generated module dependencies, and JSON output contracts must remain compatible.
tier1.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by keeping the last compatible generated profile, rejecting unclassified route or dependency movement, and documenting any required migration before promotion.

tier2.name: Tier 2 Experimental and Preview
tier2.compatibility: AI-first templates, feature plugins, remote templates, and preview extension points may evolve faster, but they must stay deterministic, path-safe, dependency-isolated, and clearly marked as preview.
tier2.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by disabling the preview feature or template, discarding generated output, and keeping the stable Tier 0 and Tier 1 generators unchanged.

commandBoundaries.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by restoring the previous generated service layout and requiring generated-service-layout-check before release.
Rollback by preserving the previous quickstart output and rejecting unexplained generated diffs.
Rollback by pinning the gozero-compatible profile and preserving goctl layout evidence.

commandBoundaries.surface: API contract to REST route generation
commandBoundaries.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving existing route layout and rejecting unclassified API import or generated route movement.
Rollback by preserving generated RPC descriptors and compatibility adapter output until smoke passes.
Rollback by pinning proto import handling and generated wrapper layout before promotion.
Rollback by preserving generated repository cache templates and keeping generated-only dependencies out of the root module.

commandBoundaries.surface: gateway route and aggregation contract generation
commandBoundaries.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by rejecting breaking aggregation changes until the generated diff is classified.
Rollback by disabling the preview template and preserving Tier 0 generated service behavior.
Rollback by reverting template sync output and preserving local path-safety checks.

commandBoundaries.surface: generation plugin execution and preview extensions
commandBoundaries.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by disabling the plugin or remote source and preserving generated output path boundaries.

releaseRules.tier0BreakingChange: block release until migration notes, compatibility evidence, and rollback plan are attached
releaseRules.tier1BreakingChange: block release unless explicitly classified as breaking-candidate with migration guidance
releaseRules.tier2BreakingChange: allow only when preview status is preserved and Tier 0/Tier 1 gates remain green
releaseRules.rootDependencyPolicy: generated-only dependencies must not enter the root module
releaseRules.runtimeArtifactPolicy: generated runtime output belongs in temporary directories and must not be committed
